confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Jakarta prices for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; lodging and alcohol vary widely by district and venue and are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set as multiples of the beer anchor (about 2.5x and 3x) because direct knowledge of Jakarta bar pricing is weak. FX 0.6955 (2026-10-15) came from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange rates table and was not verified on the page; the summaries advised confirming it. A search result also contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Based on general knowledge of Jakarta's price level, with regional context from other large Southeast Asian capitals such as Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur.
